h:
这是一个简单易用的文本到图像工作流程，适用于带有 FLUX 模型的 ComfyUI。

它专为初学者设计，专注于根据文本提示快速生成图像的基本任务。工作流程直观，最大限度地降低复杂性，确保流畅的体验。

o.en:
This is a simple and easy-to-use text-to-image workflow for ComfyUI with the FLUX model.

Designed for beginners, it focuses on essential tasks to quickly generate images from text prompts. The workflow is intuitive, minimizing complexity to ensure a smooth experience.
